terbaru.pelajaran: FastSet is a distributed protocol for decentralized finance and settlement, which is inspired from both actors and blockchains.

terbaru.judul: Proof-of-Behavior: Behavior-Driven Consensus for Trustworthy Decentralized Finance
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce Proof-of-Behavior (PoB), a consensus model that (i) gives each action a layered utility score -- covering motivation and outcome, (ii) adapts validator weights using recent scores, and (iii) applies decentralized verification with proportional slashing.

terbaru.judul: WallStreetFeds: Client-Specific Tokens as Investment Vehicles in Federated Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we propose a novel framework which introduces client-specific tokens as investment vehicles within the FL ecosystem.

terbaru.judul: DiT-SGCR: Directed Temporal Structural Representation with Global-Cluster Awareness for Ethereum Malicious Account Detection
terbaru.pelajaran: To address these challenges, we propose DiT-SGCR, an unsupervised graph encoder for malicious account detection.

terbaru.judul: A theory of Lending Protocols in DeFi
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we propose a formal model of lending protocols that captures the essential features of mainstream platforms, enabling us to identify and prove key properties related to their economic and strategic dynamics.

terbaru.judul: Explain First, Trust Later: LLM-Augmented Explanations for Graph-Based Crypto Anomaly Detection
terbaru.pelajaran: The decentralized finance (DeFi) community has grown rapidly in recent years, pushed forward by cryptocurrency enthusiasts interested in the vast untapped potential of new markets.
This document analyzes price discovery in cryptocurrency markets by comparing centralized and decentralized exchanges, as well as spot and futures markets.

terbaru.judul: Dynamic Fee for Reducing Impermanent Loss in Decentralized Exchanges
terbaru.pelajaran: To tackle these issues, we propose dynamic fee mechanisms over traditional fixed-fee structures used in automated market makers (AMM).

terbaru.judul: From Rules to Rewards: Reinforcement Learning for Interest Rate Adjustment in DeFi Lending
terbaru.pelajaran: This work applies Offline Reinforcement Learning (RL) to optimize interest rate adjustments in DeFi lending protocols.

terbaru.judul: Scaling DeFi with ZK Rollups: Design, Deployment, and Evaluation of a Real-Time Proof-of-Concept
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we examine the technical underpinnings of ZK Rollups and stress test their performance in real-world applications in decentralized finance (DeFi).
